scenes: Phnom Penh. A capital of garment factories and metal roofs, hottest before the rains.
In hot months, garment workers reporting heat symptoms rose to eighty-eight per cent.
A proposal would give the city heat thresholds.
Cooler factories protect workers, and the work.
